name: model-aware-reference-reconstruction
privacy: The user-provided comparison images are not copied into the repository; this file records only generalized visual invariants and observed drift patterns.

canonical_visual_spec.primary_subject: a split triangular ancient-futurist megastructure shown completely from apex to base
geometry_and_relations: near-black left wing and rust-red illuminated right wing remain visibly asymmetric
a thin vertical light slit connects the apex to the lower entrance
a large circular calendar relief is embedded in the upper-middle facade and partially occluded by diagonal beams
a pale horizontal relief base separates the monument from the stepped temple below
depth_layers: dry grassland and tiny red-robed observer

P1_similarity: layered temple, settlement, river, and tiny observer

required_architecture: The visual fact source is platform-neutral and contains geometry, relative scale, position, occlusion, depth order, lighting, palette, and P0/P1/P2 priorities.
Prompt compilation resolves a profile by platform, optional model, optional version, and task type; unknown model details use a conservative platform default and are never inferred from the image.
Platform adapters may change ordering, redundancy, syntax, and supported parameters, but may not change canonical visual facts.
Observed platform drift is handled as adapter-level bias correction rather than being written into the canonical visual spec.
Validation separately checks shared visual invariants and platform-specific compilation rules.

gpt: Use complete natural-language instructions and explicit spatial or occlusion relationships.
Counter unsupported beautification, symmetry inflation, and warm-color inflation only when those failure modes conflict with the source image.
Keep critical constraints close to the affected object instead of relying on a detached negative list.
grok: Use compact direct instructions while enumerating visually distinct structural zones when simplification would collapse them.
Restate P0 geometry and environmental layers without inventing platform parameters.
Counter conversion into a conventional pyramid or simplified single-volume object when the source is structurally split.
midjourney: Front-load full-shot composition, complete silhouette, subject scale, and unobstructed apex-to-base framing before attractive local details.
Describe the circular relief as a secondary embedded and partially occluded facade element so it does not take over the frame.
Append only supported conservative defaults such as source-derived aspect ratio, style raw, and relevant negative terms; do not invent a model version.

pass_criteria: All platform prompts preserve every P0 identity fact and all applicable P1 facts.
The three prompts differ materially in instruction structure rather than being translations with platform names changed.
No adapter promotes a P2 detail above P0 composition or geometry.
No exact model, version, seed, or hidden generation parameter is inferred from the source image.
The existing six-block Markdown output contract and source-image persistence behavior remain unchanged.
